summary: Vista Credit Strategic Lending Corp. filed an 8-K reporting its annual meeting results (items 5.07 and 8.01). Stockholders elected director Stephen Riddick and ratified Deloitte as auditor. Separately, the company announced a May 2026 distribution of $0.15000/share for Class I and $0.15000/share (minus $0.01386 fee) for Class S, payable on June 25, 2026 to record holders as of May 29, 2026. No special-situation event—this is a routine annual meeting update and a regular monthly dividend declaration. No special situation event.
